display ospfv3 routing (Diagnostic view)

Function

The display ospfv3 routing command displays the OSPFv3 routing table.

Format

display ospfv3 [ process-id ] routing [ [ ipv6-address prefix-length ] | ase-routes | inter-routes | intra-routes | nssa-routes ] [ verbose ] [ age { min-value min-age-value | max-value max-age-value } * ]

display ospfv3 [ process-id ] routing statistics

Parameters

Parameter Description Value
process-id

Displays information about the ABR or ASBR of an OSPF route in a specified OSPF process.

The value is an integer that ranges from 1 to 4294967295.
ipv6-address

IPv6 address.

The value is a 32-digit hexadecimal number in the format X:X:X:X:X:X:X:X.
prefix-length

Specifies the prefix length.

It is an integer ranging from 0 to 128.
ase-routes

Displays the statistics of OSPFv3 AS external routes.

-
inter-routes

Displays the statistics of OSPFv3 inter-area routes.

-
intra-routes

Displays the statistics of OSPFv3 intra-area routes.

-
nssa-routes

Displays the statistics of OSPFv3 NSSA routes.

-
verbose

Displays detailed information about OSPFv3 routes.

-
age

Displays the LSAs that age in the scope.

-
min-value min-age-value

Displays OSPFv3 routing table information with the aging time greater than or equal to min-age-value.

The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967295.
max-value max-age-value

Displays OSPFv3 routing table information with the aging time less than or equal to max-age-value.

The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967295.
statistics

Displays all routes in the OSPFv3 routing table.

-

Views

Diagnostic view

Default Level

3: Management level

Task Name and Operations

Task Name Operations
ospf debug

Usage Guidelines

Usage Scenario

With the corresponding parameters specified, you can view the routes of a specified type. The command output helps you troubleshoot OSPFv3 faults.

Example

The actual command output varies according to the device. The command output here is only an example.

# Display the OSPFv3 routing table.
<HUAWEI> system-view
[~HUAWEI] diagnose
[~HUAWEI-diagnose] display ospfv3 1 routing
Codes : E2 - Type 2 External, E1 - Type 1 External, IA - Inter-Area,
        N - NSSA
Flags : A - Added to URT6, LT - Locator Routing

Table 1 Description of the display ospfv3 routing (Diagnostic view) command output
Item Description
Codes

The following information provides the full spelling and explanation:

  • E2: Type 2 external route.
  • E1: Type 1 external route.
  • IA: Inter-area route.
  • N: NSSA route.
Type

Route type.
Flags

Flag of routing information.

A: The route is added to the IPv6 unicast routing table.

LT: locator route.
OSPFv3 Process

OSPFv3 process.
Destination

Indicates the destination IP address.
PrefixLength

Length of prefix.
NextHop

Next hop to the destination.
Interface

Outbound interface to the destination.
Metric

Cost to the destination.
Priority

Priority of OSPFv3.
Age

Route age.
AdverRouter

Advertiser.
Area

Area ID.
Nexthop Interface

Outbound interface to the destination.
Direct NextHop

Next-hop direct connection flag.
Srv6 Avoid Microloop Sid Stack

SRv6 microloop avoidance SID label stack.
CalculateTime

Route calculation time.
DownloadTime

Time when a route is delivered.
IID

IID of the next hop.
Backup Nexthop

Backup next hop.
Backup Interface

Backup outbound interface.
Backup Type

Type of the backup path.
Backup Sid Stack(Top->Bottom)

SID label stack of the backup path.
BackupIID

Backup IID.
Intra-area-routes

OSPFv3 routes in an area.
Inter-area-routes

OSPFv3 routes between areas.
External-routes

External routes.
Direct-routes

Direct routes.
